_comment: C0-15 jan bodies EN. 无附加小节。正文「相关条目」2 行带 .md 链接（lm-studio/ollama），related 写 2 条（frontmatter related 是 [openai-agents-sdk]，键按正文链接行对齐=2）。sources 4 条对齐 frontmatter。

axes.model_access: Official positioning "100% offline on your computer" (as seen in the repo description, direct-fetched); GGUF local models are the mainstay, the model list rolls with versions, not inventoried item by item.
axes.runtime: Desktop app (Jan's own runtime: the jan-core/jan-engine line); GitHub 45,158★ (API verified 2026-10-21). The repo now sits under Menlo Research (janhq/jan; menloresearch/jan is the old path with a 301 redirect, direct-fetch verified).
axes.local_files: Conversations and models all land on your machine (the official "100% offline on your computer" stance, as seen in the repo description, direct-fetched).
axes.background: A built-in local API server (OpenAI-compatible) can stay on; details not verified item by item.
axes.tools: A plugin/extension ecosystem is within the official docs line; MCP support status not verified item by item, third-party extension quality not inventoried.
axes.context: Session context management is in-app; cross-session memory and long-term memory — no official statement seen (not-verified ≠ absent).
axes.permissions: Desktop-app permissions follow the OS grant; no account system, and under the offline positioning no cloud-sync permission surface seen.
axes.fit: Fits: wanting an open-source desktop GUI for offline local models (vs closed-source LM Studio). Does not fit: service-style multi-model deployment; wanting latest models out of the box (the model-acquisition experience is weaker than Ollama's).

runs: This site has not completed measured runs. The closest test protocol is the code-side [protocols/framework/_protocol.md](../../../protocols/framework/_protocol.md) (the local-endpoint and credential-boundary sections are reusable; no runner-specific protocol exists on this site yet).
unknowns:
- The model-format support matrix of the jan-core/jan-engine runtime (not verified item by item)
- MCP support status (not verified item by item)
- The legal-binding boundary of the attribution request (is the Apache extra sentence a request or a condition — this site makes no legal judgment)
related: Both desktop GUIs: LM Studio is closed-source but aggressive on the agent narrative, Jan is open-source with a steadier cadence.
Ollama is stronger on model acquisition and the CLI line; Jan's value is the open-source desktop shell.
